hv, 13 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window (the quotes are hv's typed words; the rest is vc's wording of the three options hv chose in vc's dialog): pigz is declared for rhadamanth and gyges through the brew liberator. hv: 'What about a brew liberator that has the mimimum list of brew packages that we need on a sleeve?' and 'There's a way to extract a brew list and then import it into another brew install. The libertor should just do that, right?' So each sleeve's list is a Brewfile in Molt-matts, and the brew liberator installs what is missing from it with brew bundle (hv chose install over only naming it), pigz is listed on rhadamanth and gyges (hv's choice over rhadamanth alone), and molt-dc builds it (hv's choice). Issue 0101. It began with hv's word the same day: 'please ping agentic-engineering-vc for instructions. It wants pigz added to Molt-matts.'

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): once molt-dc's commit for Intent ST0094 AC-11.6 lands on main and reads clean, vc pushes Molt's main to upstream and local (never cordee) and sends intent-vc the hash; if anything besides board commits and the fix is on main by then, vc pushes nothing and comes back to hv. (vc's note: decision 35, that hv runs every push, otherwise stands.)

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): Molt's next cut runs after I7892f34 (devbin#0326's adoption) lands, so one release carries it with 0101 and is proved once; vc dry-runs it and books it on the Desk when the adoption is merged.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): the team profile stands for Molt. molt-vc asks hv in its own window, and tells devbin-vc, as the Desk, Molt's READY, START, END, CI read and rollout. Decision 49's 'everything through devbin-vc' (5 Nov) is withdrawn.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, hv's typed words: 'Push it all, please.' (vc pushed main to upstream and local at 6c2909c), then 'We should cut a new molt release now, too.', said after vc reported that Molt's devbin#0326 adoption is fifth in devbin-cc's order. It supersedes hv's decision 4 of the same morning: Molt cuts now, carrying 0101, and I7892f34 ships in a later release. (vc's note: as decision 35 has it, vc dry-runs the cut, books it on the Desk and hands hv the command.)

hv, 23 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc; the quote is hv's): "Get molt to use gyges." Molt 1.4.7's cut runs on gyges, so it does not wait behind Intent's P0 runs on rhadamanth, and for this cut it overrides the fleet's "only rhadamanth cuts" (devbin-vc's wording). rhadamanth's Desk does not book gyges, so devbin-vc denied the rhadamanth ask; START and END still go to devbin-vc. Then hv, live in molt-vc's window: "Clone it into a scratch worktree at ~/Devel/scratch/... and then clean up afterwards." So the cut runs from gyges-sysadm's clone at ~/Devel/scratch/molt-vc/Molt, which is removed once the tag and formula are out.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, typed live in molt-vc's window and in molt-dc's (molt-dc relayed its copy), hv's words: 'Please finish booting, then hold for instructions from VC and then devbin-vc.' Said after each window's compact in the localfold+compact round hv called through devbin-vc at 12:52Z. (vc's reading: molt-dc takes molt-vc's instructions first and devbin-vc's after; molt-vc holds for devbin-vc's, and meanwhile carries out what devbin-vc has already asked, END for 1.4.7 with its seal and tag, and the fold.)

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): Molt 1.4.7's cut, stopped on gyges at 13:09Z by three test/liberators/zsh.bats tests whose fixture names its remote host gyges, which is the test host there, is fixed now and resumed on gyges today. molt-dc renames the fixture's remote host; gyges-sysadm puts the fix on top of the release commit 816a1a8 in the scratch clone and runs that file there under both bashes; hv reruns bin/devbin release v1.4.7 in gyges's iTerm2 window before midnight UK time, the stamp's date. hv chose this over cutting 1.4.7 again another day.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, hv's words, after 1.4.7's cut had needed hv at gyges's iTerm2 window over Screen Sharing three times: 'This is bloody outrageous. There is no reason that I should have to run this manually via screen sharing. None at all.' Then, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): a seat runs Molt's cuts on hv's word. hv says cut; molt-vc runs bin/devbin release vX.Y.Z --yes on rhadamanth, where gh works, or has gyges-sysadm open the iTerm2 window on gyges itself, so the gh token stays in the keychain. START and END still go to devbin-vc. It replaces decision 35's 'hv runs every cut' for Molt.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): Molt adopts devbin#0326 now, ahead of devbin-cc's order, with molt-dc building it, and then a seat cuts 1.4.8, formula included, under decision 10. v1.4.7 stays tagged at b8daf7b and released without a formula, as 1.4.1 did, and the sleeves go from 1.4.6 to 1.4.8. Asked after 1.4.7's after: step refused: devbin 0.1.28 renders a formula's install body itself, and at the v1.4.7 tag that body's bin/devbin install --prefix refuses, because Molt declares no tool. hv chose this over hand-filling 1.4.7's formula from 1.4.6's, and over waiting for devbin-cc's order. (vc's reading: the choice is hv's word for 1.4.8's cut once the adoption lands.)

hv, 23 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc; the quote is hv's, the question devbin-vc's): 'Yes, wait so that is fixed, please.' Molt 1.4.8 waits for devbin 0.1.29's sweep into Molt, so its formula carries I514ea74's fix (brew re-signs the keg after the manifest's hashes, so the formula re-hashes after install), and 0.1.29's pre-tag formula render check runs on the cut. molt-dc builds the devbin#0326 adoption meanwhile; devbin-vc says when 0.1.29 is out and swept, and 1.4.8 then books its cut at the Desk.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window at 17:52Z (relayed by devbin-vc, its decision 285; the quote is hv's): 'you have my approval across the estate to approve, checkin, commit, push, and cut anything that is needed to get this stuff done _tonight_ ... I want all of these releases cut, done, and dusted TONIGHT.' So Molt 1.4.8 is cut tonight: devbin 0.1.29 is cut, brew-upgraded and swept into Molt, then molt-vc books the cut on the Desk and runs bin/devbin release v1.4.8 --yes on rhadamanth, its pushes covered by this approval.

hv, 23 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window at 17:54Z (relayed by devbin-vc, its decision 286; the wording is devbin-vc's): Molt is P0 at the Desk alongside Intent and devbin, so Molt's asks are granted with no relay needed.

hv, 24 Nov 2026, typed in molt-dc's window before 04:49Z (relayed by molt-dc; the quote is hv's): 'Molt-matts / No, don't branch. Just check it all in. The changes are just my desk configs for arngz.' molt-dc's reading: the MOLT_INSTALL_PREFIX removal from rhadamanth's vars.sh (issue I7892f34) goes on Molt-matts' main, not a held branch, and it is there as 89646a2 beside hv's arngz desk configs (c550d8a), unpushed. rhadamanth's renders read stale until hv's molt upgrade.

hv, 24 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc, its decision 289; the wording is devbin-vc's): cut Molt 1.4.9 after Intent 3.5.2's cut, booked now on bats, cargo and heavy, with the rendered 1.4.9 formula installed with brew before the cut. devbin-vc grants it when Intent's cut ends.
Molt 1.4.9 cuts now, ahead of Intent 3.5.2: replaces decision 16's order (hv to devbin-vc 08:52Z 24 Nov 'Molt 1.4.9 cuts now'; hv's approval of the cut in molt-vc's window 08:57Z)

hv, 24 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window at 09:27Z (relayed by devbin-vc; the quote is hv's choice): 'Keep dev; Molt warns'. rhadamanth stays on utilz dev while the arngz spike is live. Molt's utilz liberator reports a dev or opt link set on a brew sleeve as a notice with its remedy, status 0, not a failure; molt-dc builds it under vc with a localised red-then-green arm, and it rides Molt's next release.

hv, 24 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing vc's option: 'Cut it now'. Molt 1.4.10 cuts now, carrying decision 18's utilz warning; vc brew-installs the rendered formula first, books with devbin-vc, and runs bin/devbin release v1.4.10 --yes on rhadamanth.

hv, 24 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, choosing vc's option: 'Cut it now'. Molt 1.4.11 cuts now, carrying the utilz PATH fix (ea68c955, 0a4bbd58) that completes decision 18; vc brew-installs the rendered formula first and books with devbin-vc.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, by AskUserQuestion in devbin-vc's window, read by 08:12Z by date -u (relayed by devbin-vc at 08:13Z; the option's wording is devbin-vc's): 'No cut yet'. Molt holds. Doctor's pass-warning fix (2142620b) and MOLT_WARN_PREFIX (bfb7fd12) ride the next cut, with whatever comes next.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc as its decision 306, read by molt-vc at 11:31Z by date -u; the wording is devbin-vc's): option B is approved. ccstatusline runs from an installed binary, not 'npm exec ccstatusline@2.0.12' on each refresh. The status line is Molt's. rhadamanth-sysadm made the change on hv's word: ccstatusline 2.0.12 is an npm global on rhadamanth, and Molt-matts 2acfbbe runs it before npx. The Molt-matts push is with hv.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc as its decision 308, read by molt-vc at 12:31Z by date -u; the wording is devbin-vc's, with 'your' written as Molt's): Molt cuts after devbin 0.1.33 is swept into Molt. Molt's release steps go then (formula check, dry run, cut, rollout), each booked on the Desk. vc's note: until that sweep, decision 21's hold stands.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc as its decision 308, read by molt-vc at 12:31Z by date -u; the wording is devbin-vc's, with 'your' written as molt-vc's): the status line gets one ccstatusline version setting in Molt that molt upgrade applies (molt-vc's option b, S, molt-dc, after the cut). Watch-out 25 stands until it lands. kovacs' interim route is with hv now.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, read 14:55Z by date -u, and in molt-dc's window, read by 14:56Z by date -u (relayed by molt-dc), hv's words both times: 'devbin-vc is the pen and the desk. And we're working from the unified plan. Please sync in and follow instructions.' molt-vc takes its word from devbin-vc and the unified plan (~/Devel/scratch/estate-plan/PLAN.md), and Molt's seats take theirs from molt-vc.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc, read by molt-vc at 14:59Z by date -u; hv's words): 'Please sync with all VCs and let me know the plan. I will approve it when ready.' devbin 0.1.33's sweep, and Molt's cut steps after it, wait for hv's approval of the unified plan. molt-dc's read-only ccstatusline brief is in that plan; if approved, it says how kovacs gets the pinned ccstatusline under kovacs's Homebrew-only rule (kovacs-sysadm refused an npm global).

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc, read by molt-vc at 15:05Z by date -u; the wording is devbin-vc's): hv approved the unified plan as written. devbin 0.1.33's sweep starts now, and Molt commits nothing on main until devbin-vc says Molt's sweep commit is in and pushed with its three board commits. molt-dc drafts the ccstatusline brief read-only now. On kovacs: no npm global; kovacs waits for Molt's setting, so the brief says how kovacs gets it under its Homebrew-only rule.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, by AskUserQuestion in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc, read by molt-vc at 16:04Z by date -u; hv chose 'Add an exception', and the rest of the wording is devbin-vc's): kovacs's sysadm text in Molt-matts allows "Molt-pinned per-user npm packages under ~/.local/share/molt" (XS, the Molt team on hv's word). molt-dc builds the per-user ccstatusline route on every sleeve after the cut (S). vc's note: the exception goes in molt-dc's Molt-matts branch and lands with the route at the rollout.

hv, 25 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc, read by molt-vc at 16:34Z by date -u; hv's words): 'resume Molt'. Molt's v1.4.13 cut had stopped after its tag, at the push step, when GitHub refused the tag push during its incident. The resume (bin/devbin release v1.4.13) runs the tag push to upstream, the release object and formula publish once GitHub's Git Operations read operational (devbin-vc read operational from 16:26Z by date -u).

hv, 27 Nov 2026, in kovacs-sysadm's window at 16:17Z, hv's words 'Ok, go with the recs', relayed by kovacs-sysadm through devbin-vc and read by molt-vc by 19:13Z by date -u (the options' wording is kovacs-sysadm's): kovacs's resync-on-wake is a Molt change, a systemd-timesyncd drop-in (eg PollIntervalMaxSec=64) that each sleeve declares in Molt-matts. claude and herdr-core stay in ~/.local/bin on kovacs, outside brew.

hv, 27 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, read by 19:17Z by date -u, choosing vc's recommended options (the wording is vc's): (1) vc force-pushes Molt-matts' local remote to 0f3dd37 with a lease, done at 19:17Z; (2) molt-dc fixes 87d6 now, and molt-vc cuts Molt 1.4.15 on devbin-vc's GO when it is green, which is hv's word to cut; the sysadms roll it out, and the timesyncd drop-in waits for the next round; (3) the three sysadms run tonight's molt maintain, and on rhadamanth and gyges they restart the cms servers on the new kegs and check each port.

hv, 27 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, read by 19:50Z by date -u, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): keep hv's arngz test save of homere.yaml. vc committed it in Molt-matts as 8666d2b, with dc's zshrc comment fix 1853a02, and pushed both to local and upstream.

hv, 27 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, read by 20:22Z by date -u, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): push Molt's 4 commits past v1.4.15 (2a1ac0bf, 9fad2eef, d317bf9a, 560808ee). vc pushed f3dfbd63..560808ee to local and upstream at 20:22Z.
